# Editor, boards & sharing

A file editor, whiteboards per project, and threads you can share by link, move to another machine or clean up.

Pack id `files`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/editor`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/editor/README.md) — Monaco file editor for DSH: workspace file tree, tabs, open-from-anywhere and confined saving.
2. [`@dshfiles/whiteboard`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/whiteboard/README.md) — Per-project Excalidraw whiteboards stored on the Host, with agent tools to list, read, write and delete them.
3. [`@dshfiles/thread-share`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/thread-share/README.md) — Share one DSH thread as a read-only live or snapshot page behind an unguessable link, optionally passphrase-protected, with expiry, revoke and view counts; plus a self-contained HTML export and an opt-in, time-bounded Tailscale Funnel / cloudflared publish helper.
4. [`@dshfiles/thread-transfer`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/thread-transfer/README.md) — Export a thread to a portable .dshthread bundle (messages, tool calls, attachments, title, model) and import one as a new thread on another machine.
5. [`@dshfiles/conversation-cleanup`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/conversation-cleanup/README.md) — Preview and permanently purge cold settled or archived local conversations under their native write locks.

## Prerequisites

1. A project is added.

## Key settings

None.

## Features

From the onboarding feature catalog: 14 features, the 0 curated ones first.

### More

1. **Edit thread artifacts** (`editor`, thread-panel) — Create and edit Markdown and HTML documents that belong to a thread, which the agent can edit too.
2. **Browse and edit workspace files** (`editor`, thread-panel) — Browse and edit the workspace's files in tabs, with search, go to line and Markdown preview.
3. **Open file links in the editor** (`editor`, thread-panel) — A file link in a thread opens the file in the editor, reusing its tab when it is already open.
4. **Index workspace files with bounded traversal** (`editor`) — The workspace's file list loads in steps and skips version control and dependency folders.
5. **Open thread and workspace files for other plugins** (`editor`) — Other features can read which thread is on screen and list or search its workspace files.
6. **Project whiteboards** (`whiteboard`, knowledge) — Draw on whiteboards kept per project, with autosave and a Recently deleted list.
7. **Agent-drawn diagrams** (`whiteboard`) — The agent can draw diagrams on a whiteboard that you can then edit.
8. **State machine diagrams** (`whiteboard`) — A state machine can be drawn as a diagram on a whiteboard or in Markdown.
9. **Share a thread as a read-only link** (`thread-share`, settings) — Share a thread as a read-only link, live or frozen, with an optional passphrase and expiry.
10. **Freeze a snapshot or download a self-contained HTML export** (`thread-share`, settings) — Freeze a shared thread as a snapshot, or download it as one HTML file.
11. **Publish share pages through a time-bounded tunnel** (`thread-share`, settings) — Publish share pages outside your network through a tunnel that closes after a set time.
12. **Export a thread to a file** (`thread-transfer`, threads) — Export a thread with its messages, tool calls and attachments to one file you can import elsewhere.
13. **Import a thread from a file** (`thread-transfer`) — Import an exported thread file as a new thread after a preview of what it holds.
14. **Permanently clean up done or archived threads** (`conversation-cleanup`, settings) — Preview done or archived threads and permanently delete their logs after you confirm.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Editor, boards & sharing under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `files`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs files` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
